import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final

import pytest

NOTES_DIR: Final = Path("notes")


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first name in ``names`` readable from ``notes``.

    Each name is resolved relative to the ``notes`` directory under the current
    working directory. Names are untrusted: any name that resolves outside
    ``notes`` (via ``..``, an absolute path, or a symlink) is skipped. Missing,
    unreadable, or non-regular files are skipped too. Returns the empty string
    when no name yields a readable file.
    """
    root = NOTES_DIR.resolve()
    for name in names:
        try:
            candidate = (root / name).resolve()
        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError):
            # ValueError: embedded NUL byte; OSError/RuntimeError: symlink loops.
            continue
        if not candidate.is_relative_to(root) or candidate == root:
            continue
        try:
            if not candidate.is_file():
                continue
            return candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            # OSError: permission or I/O failure; ValueError: UnicodeDecodeError.
            continue
    return ""


def test_returns_first_readable_in_order(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["missing.txt", "b.txt", "a.txt"]) == "beta"
    assert first_readable(["a.txt", "b.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_empty_list_returns_empty_string(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    assert first_readable([]) == ""


def test_none_readable_returns_empty_string(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    assert first_readable(["nope.txt", "also-nope.txt"]) == ""


def test_notes_dir_missing_returns_empty_string(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["a.txt"]) == ""


def test_parent_traversal_is_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_absolute_path_is_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    outside = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    outside.write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable([str(outside)]) == ""


def test_traversal_does_not_block_later_valid_name(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "ok.txt").write_text("ok", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt", "ok.txt"]) == "ok"


def test_directory_name_is_skipped(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (notes / "real.txt").write_text("real", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub", "real.txt"]) == "real"


def test_symlink_escaping_notes_is_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    outside = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    outside.write_text("secret", encoding="utf-8")
    link = notes / "link.txt"
    try:
        os.symlink(outside, link)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks not supported here")
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""


def test_nul_byte_name_is_rejected(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes.mkdir()
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a.txt\x00.png", "a.txt"]) == "alpha"
    assert first_readable(["a.txt\x00"]) == ""
